about: The welcome tutorial 'Welcome to Bon Adventure' (PWA restructure phase 6, 12 Nov 2026), played by scripts/learning/tutorial.gd once per profile. Guide: docs/guides/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_PART1.md#welcome-tutorial. Three acts; progress is saved per profile at the start of each act (the checkpoint), so every act begins with a 'place' step that puts the player and the cast where the act needs them. Since 14 Nov 2026 (user) the family bathroom door is open from the start (the friend there is behind one thing, the curtain) and BonBon waits in the living room by the teal chair, out from the wall, turned between that door and the suite. Since 13 Nov 2026 (user review) the player wakes in the guest suite (the south-east bedroom), only the suite, family bathroom, yellow bedroom (friend 2) and, at the end, front doors open, the market act keeps the player at the supermarket and its parking lot, and the statue step holds the player still with only the statue clickable. Cast roles: 'guide' and 'friend_1', 'friend_2' (the ids in 'friends'; one that is the player's avatar is replaced by the next house character in data/house_characters.json order). Spaces: 'home' = the home site's local coordinates (town units, as in scripts/buildings/home.gd), 'world' = world metres. 'look' is an [x, z] direction in that space; a cast member stands on the ground below 'at' unless 'ground' is false (then exactly at 'at': Sunny inside the bathtub). Lines are data/phrases.json ids; tutorial.* lines are spoken in the player's native language, 'learning': true lines in the language being learned. Step types: place, say, hint, wait, door, walk (an optional 'look' [x, z] turns the walker at the end), cutscene, shop (scripts/learning/tutorial_shop.gd), words (word cards on or off: 'on'; they are off from the start until this step, 13 Nov 2026; 'only': the one word key a click may open), lock (every door of 'space' except those named in 'open' says 'line' instead of opening; 'off': unlock), confine ('rects' [x0, z0, x1, z1] in 'space' the player stays inside, or 'hold': stay where you are; neither = free; 'line' flashes when held back). A place step's 'open_on' (a cast role) starts the close-up on that actor while the screen is dark, so the act opens on them talking (14 Nov 2026: BonBon, not the player in bed). Controls (16 Nov 2026, user): right after waking BonBon teaches turning the view and walking. A wait step 'for': 'view' ends when the player turned the view by hand ('turn' radians, a mouse or finger drag; or zoomed 'zoom' metres), 'for': 'move' when they walked 'distance' metres; meanwhile the matching control pulses (scripts/ui/tutorial_cue.gd; on a touch screen the joystick itself, touch_controls.gd highlight_stick(); 'cue' names another control than 'for'). Any say or hint step's 'touch_line' and a wait step's 'touch_where' replace 'line' / 'where' on a touch screen (hud.touch_mode; the first touch switches a showing hint). 'card_seconds': a word card opened during the tutorial closes by itself after this many seconds (user, 14 Nov 2026; interaction_controller.gd card_seconds). 'hide': nodes (paths under the town) hidden while the tutorial runs and shown again when it ends or is skipped (the mahjong table with its players, user 14 Nov 2026). A cast entry's 'camera' [x, y, z] fixes that actor's close-up camera spot (npc_presence.gd meta talk_camera_at). A wait step's 'where' is the phrase BonBon says when the player talks to her during it (where to go next); the shop trip has its own (tutorial_shop.gd where()). 'door': the supermarket doorway's invisible wall until the fruit is paid for (centre 'at', 'size' [across the doorway's depth, height, width], 'inward' [x, z] into the store; 14 Nov 2026). Shop items: one apple and one banana (13 Nov 2026; the order of two apples left players who picked one of each waiting), on the fruit table inside the supermarket's door (supermarket step tutorial_fruit). Tutorial script of 17 Nov 2026 (user): BonBon's lines are separate bubbles that move on by themselves (reading time, 0.6 s gap; a click, tap, E or Enter moves on) and hold the player; what to DO shows in the instruction strip (scripts/ui/instruction_strip.gd): a step 'strip' with its phrase ('line' / 'touch_line', or 'off'), or a wait step's 'strip' / 'touch_strip' shown while it waits. 'controls' steps allow 'look', 'move', 'use' (missing = true): first only E, then the view, then walking. 'find': the hiding friends in either order ('friends': 'role', 'hello' in the language being learned, 'hints' when asked, general to exact; a 'curtain' friend is near 'at' / 'radius' in 'space', BonBon says 'approach', the strip says 'strip' and the curtain opens with E (17 Nov 2026, user; it stays shut until the hunt); else 'radius' around the friend; each greeting waits for the player's 'reply' button, and the first introduces the EN button), 'objective' in the strip with the count, 'first' and 'all' said by BonBon. A lock step's 'remark' doors open with BonBon's 'remark_line' during the hunt; the other closed doors flash 'line'. 'pause': 'seconds' (the cast walking off). A cutscene's 'subtitle'; it can be skipped once the buildings are in and the later acts' views are drawn behind it. Review of 17 Nov 2026 (user): a say step's 'reply' is a button the line waits for (good_morning: 'Yes!'); BonBon's lines are in a close-up while she is near and standing; a 'view' wait counts zooming only with 'zoom'; a 'move' wait counts the way walked; a lock step's 'open_in' (building units) keeps their doors usable (the market act: the supermarket), the town acts lock every other door with 'not_right_place'; only doors and BonBon can be used during the tutorial; it starts at noon; the cast walks at the player's walking speed. A place step's 'picnic' ('at' [x, y, z], 'look') lays the blanket with the bought food (shop items). Shop: 'items' 1 apple, 2 bananas, 3 cookies (2 dollars 50), 'money' the denominations offered ($1 bills and quarters), 'hints' {fruit, cookie} when asked.
